form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Unique ID of this component on the dashboard, generated when the component is added (e.g. stroomql-table-AB1C2). It cannot be changed.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this component, shown in its tab on the dashboard.

form:FormGroup.label: Query
form:FormGroup.helpText: StroomQL Query component whose results this table shows. Several tables can show the same query's results, each with its own sorting, filters and formatting.

form:FormGroup.label: Table Page Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of rows shown on each page of the table, from 1 to 10,000. Default is 100.
